$comment: Generated by pnpm plugin schema. Do not edit.

discord.dm.send.description: Send a member of this server a direct message (5 per member per hour)

discord.member.get.description: A member of this server, or null when they are not in it

discord.messages.delete.description: Delete a message this plugin posted

discord.messages.edit.description: Edit a message this plugin posted

discord.messages.remove.description: Delete anyone's message, with a reason for the audit log

discord.messages.send.description: Post a message (text, embeds, buttons, selects) in a channel of this server; default: the channel of the command, click or event (memberJoin, memberLeave, levelUp and caseCreated have none, so pass channelId)

discord.reactions.add.description: React to a message with a unicode emoji or a custom emoji ID

discord.roles.add.description: Give a member a role. Roles with staff permissions need a caller with Manage Roles

discord.roles.list.description: This server's roles, highest first, with whether each grants staff permissions

discord.roles.remove.description: Take a role from a member. Roles with staff permissions need a caller with Manage Roles

discord.threads.create.description: Start a thread in a channel, or from a message

kv.delete.description: Remove a key; reports whether it existed

kv.get.description: Read a value; null when the key is not set

kv.increment.description: Atomically add to a counter (missing keys start at 0) and return the new value

kv.list.description: Keys that start with a prefix, sorted, at most 100

kv.set.description: Write a value (up to 4 KB, 1000 keys per server)

levels.get.description: A member's XP, level and leaderboard position in this server

moderation.ban.description: Ban a user. For a temporary ban, schedule a moderation.unban with schedule.create

moderation.history.description: A member's moderation cases in this server, newest first

moderation.timeout.description: Time a member out for 1 minute to 28 days

moderation.warn.description: Warn a member; counts towards the server’s escalation

schedule.cancel.description: Cancel the pending run with this key

schedule.create.description: Run handle_job later (10 seconds to a year), with data. A key replaces any run with the same key

schedule.list.description: Pending runs in this server, soonest first

xp.grant.description: Give XP to a member (default: who ran the command). Each plugin can give a member at most 100 XP every 10 minutes
